cases.name: etaf-tanks-drive-and-fire-accept-simultaneous-input

cases.name: etaf-tanks-world-runs-without-input-and-pauses-atomically
cases.purpose: Physics and enemy AI advance independently of commands and freeze while paused.

cases.purpose: Swept tank collisions prevent the player from driving through another tank.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-invalid-orders-preserve-paused-world
cases.purpose: Invalid coordinates, directions and snapshot arguments preserve accepted state.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-shells-stop-at-cover
cases.purpose: A live projectile stops at cover instead of passing through walls.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-native-controls-can-win-and-restart
cases.purpose: Rendered controls fight autonomous enemies to victory and restart the battle.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-enemies-can-end-an-unattended-battle
cases.purpose: An unattended live battle can reach defeat without more player input.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-snapshots-restore-paused-with-atomic-rejection
cases.purpose: Snapshots restore positions and resources while malformed files preserve the match.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-themes-and-resize-preserve-paused-battle
cases.purpose: Appearance and resizing preserve the battlefield, state and keyboard focus.

cases.purpose: One running instance cannot advance a second paused battlefield.
